note_en: 如同……一般 frames a comparison in written style: 如同被雷击中一般 "as if struck by lightning." 如同 ("just like") opens the image and 一般 ("the same way") closes it, a bit like English "as if... " but with a word on each side. In everyday speech you'd hear 像……一样 instead.
